result:
Looking at each task, I need to write qlang queries based on the documentation provided. Let me work through them carefully:

S1: Filter for open issues with "bug" in labels (case-insensitive), then count.

S2: Filter for open issues, remove null assignees, group by assignee, count per group.

S3: Filter for open issues, sort by priority (missing=0) descending then id ascending, take top 3, extract ids.

S4: Filter dependencies and devDependencies for "^" versions, combine, deduplicate, and sort.

S5: Calculate order totals, group by customer, sum totals, get top 2 with formatted output.

S6: Navigate to data.users, filter for Berlin (case-insensitive, handle missing/null profile), extract emails lowercased and sorted.

S7: Split lines into fields, filter for ERROR level (case-insensitive), group by service, count.

S8: Parse CSV (skip header), filter non-empty salaries, group by lowercase dept, average salaries.

S9: Filter published=true, extract and deduplicate tags per article, count occurrences, top 3.

S10: Filter services where enabled=true, map to service name and port.

S11: Filter products with stock > 0, extract categories, lowercase, deduplicate, sort.

S12: Split sentence by spaces, lowercase, group by word, count, sort and get top 3.

S13: Group events by user, count and find earliest timestamp, sort by user.

S14: Skip comments/blanks, split by |, filter region and status, sort by uptime, join names.

S1: filter /state eq "open" | filter ~(/labels * lower | any eq "bug") | count
S2: filter /state eq "open" | filter ~(/assignee ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee) | * count
S3: filter /state eq "open" | sort ~([(at :priority | coalesce 0 | desc) /id]) | take 3 | * /id
S4: [(/dependencies | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys) (/devDependencies | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys)] | flat | distinct | sort
S5: * {customer: /customer, total: (/items | * (/qty * /price) | sum)} | groupBy ~(/customer) | * * /total | sum | sort ~(desc) | take 2 | entries | * {customer: (/0 | print), total: (/1 | round 2)}
S6: /data/users | filter ~(/profile | coalesce {} | at :city | coalesce "" | lower eq "berlin") | * /email | * lower | sort
S7: lines | * (split " ") | filter ~(/[1] | lower eq "error") | groupBy ~(/[2]) | * count
S8: lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~(/[2] ne "") | groupBy ~(/[1] | lower) | * (* /[2] | * parseJson | avg) | * (round 1)
S9: filter /published | * (at :tags | coalesce [] | * lower | distinct) | flat | groupBy ~(.) | * count | entries | sort ~([(/1 | desc) (/0)]) | take 3 | * {tag: (/0 | print), count: /1}
S10: /services | filter ~(/enabled eq true) | * (at :port)
S11: filter ~(/stock gt 0) | * /category | * lower | distinct | sort
S12: "The cat and the Hat and THE bat sat on a mat with the cat" | split " " | * lower | groupBy ~(.) | * count | entries | sort ~([(/1 | desc) (/0)]) | take 3 | * {word: (/0 | print), count: /1}
S13: groupBy ~(/user) | entries | * {user: (/0 | print), count: (/1 | count), first: (/1 | min ~(/ts))} | sort ~(/user)
S14: lines | filter ~(. ne "") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | * (split "|") | filter ~(/[1] | lower | startsWith "eu-") | filter ~(/[2] ne "down") | sort ~((/[3] | parseJson | desc)) | * /[0] | join ","
